title: German, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Entrance to major requires a 2.00 GPA and third-semester classification, not modeled directly. New ger_catalog.json (13 courses). Unlike French (no coded prereq chain), German's GER 1->2->3 IS a formally coded prereq chain, confirmed via direct DOM inspection (same behavior as Spanish's SPAN 1->2->3). Two real data artifacts found and fixed: the bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan cites plain 'GER 200', which no longer exists (current course is GER 200N) -- used GER 200N; and 'GER 208Y' (an alternative to GER 201) could not be confirmed to exist anywhere in the department's full course listing -- dropped, GER 201 used as the sole literal pick. '100-level GER' is modeled as a generic slot. 'LA 283' (the same unconfirmed code hit throughout recent Liberal Arts builds) replaced with a generic slot. RE-VERIFIED against the live bulletin (2026-08): the prior judgment call to keep GER 310 as a literal Prescribed pick (instead of the requirements summary's GER 402) turned out to be WRONG once re-checked against the current live page -- the live Suggested Academic Plan itself now places GER 402 in Fall Year 3, not GER 310 or GER 344 (neither of which appears anywhere in the current German B.A. requirements or suggested plan at all -- both belong to the separate German B.S., not the B.A.). Fixed 4 real bugs: (1) added GER 402 (a genuinely Prescribed course, previously entirely missing from this plan) in Semester 6, replacing the old generic '300/400-level GER Course' placeholder there. (2) Removed GER 344 (Semester 6) and GER 310 (Semester 7) -- neither is real for the B.A. -- replacing both with real 'German literature/culture' picks. (3) The 'GER Literature/Culture Course' pool only had 2 occurrences (6cr) but the live requirements page requires 9cr (3 courses) from an explicit enumerated list (GER 431, 432, 440, 456, 457, 458, 459) -- now 3 occurrences (Semester 6, 7 x2), all enumerated instead of generic. Semester 8's now-redundant 4th occurrence converted to a plain Elective. (4) The German-linguistics pool (Semester 7) was missing GER 435 -- the live page's real list is GER 411, 412, 430, OR 435, not just the first three.
